mentions.name: DSAPrep
mentions.description: This tool helps users stay on track and revise LeetCode DSA (data structures and algorithms) problems in a structured, stress-free way for interview preparation. Launched at https://dsaprep.dev.
mentions.problem: Keeping DSA revision for interview prep on track can be unstructured and stressful.
